name: PrettySmooth
description: Optimizes the WHOLE game (menus, levels and editor) on PC and mobile. Includes UltraSmooth mode.

title-general.name: General / FPS
title-general.description: Tip: the purple PrettySmooth menu (PS button in the main menu, pause menu and editor pause) is the easiest way to configure everything, and it can be switched to Portuguese.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description:
Applies a group of settings at once.

<cp>Vanilla</c>: original game.
<cp>Balanced</c>: light, almost no visual loss.
<cp>Performance</c>: cuts heavy effects.
<cp>Potato</c>: makes the game UGLY to run on anything.
<cp>UltraSmooth</c>: maximum smoothness.
<cp>Custom</c>: you changed something manually.

fps-unlock.name: Custom FPS limit
fps-unlock.description: Ignores the game's FPS limit and uses 'Target FPS'. On weak phones, locking at 60 gives a steadier game than an unstable 90.

fps-target.name: Target FPS
fps-target.description: FPS used when 'Custom FPS limit' is on. On mobile the real maximum is the screen refresh rate.

vsync-off.name: Force VSync off
vsync-off.description: Turns VSync off even if the game tries to turn it on. Less input lag and FPS above the monitor refresh rate (may tear).

frame-pacing.name: Smooth Frame Pacing (menus)
frame-pacing.description: Smooths frame times in menus to remove micro-stutters. Never touches levels, so clicks stay exact.

high-priority.name: High priority
high-priority.description: Asks Windows to give Geometry Dash CPU priority.

precise-timer.name: High precision timer
precise-timer.description: Uses the 1ms Windows timer for a steadier FPS limiter.

fps-counter.name: Purple FPS counter
fps-counter.description: Shows an FPS counter in the corner of the screen.

level-particles.name: Level particles
level-particles.description: Normal, Reduced (uses the percentage below) or Off.

particle-amount.name: Particle amount (%)
particle-amount.description: Percentage of particles kept when the mode is 'Reduced' (levels, menus and editor).

no-shaders.name: Disable shaders
no-shaders.description: Ignores shader triggers (blur, glitch, chromatic, etc). Very heavy on phones.

no-glow.name: Remove glow
no-glow.description: Hides the object glow layers. May hide glow decorations (ugly, runs better).

force-ldm.name: Force Low Detail Mode
force-ldm.description: Turns on LDM in every level that has high detail objects, without changing your saved choice.

no-trails.name: Disable trails
no-trails.description: Disables the player and ship trails (motion streak).

static-menu.name: Static main menu
static-menu.description: Freezes the animated main menu background (no running icons).

transitions.name: Transitions
transitions.description: Speed of the fade transitions between screens.

editor-no-glow.name: Editor without glow
editor-no-glow.description: Hides the glow layers in the editor (does not change the saved level).

editor-no-shaders.name: Editor without shaders
editor-no-shaders.description: Ignores the shader preview in the editor and playtest.

editor-grid.name: Draw editor grid
editor-grid.description: Turning it off removes the grid and guide lines (much lighter in huge levels).

editor-throttle.name: Editor visibility updates
editor-throttle.description: 1 = every frame (normal). 2-4 = updates object visibility every N frames when NOT playtesting. Much lighter in huge levels.

texture-quality.name: Texture quality
texture-quality.description: Game's texture quality. 'Low' uses much less GPU memory and bandwidth (best for weak phones). Needs a game restart.

low-textures.name: 16-bit textures
low-textures.description: Loads textures in 16-bit: half the video memory. Gradients look ugly. Needs a game restart.

clean-memory.name: Free memory when leaving levels
clean-memory.description: Frees unused textures when leaving a level or the editor. Great for phones with little RAM.
